source: values a property cannot be converted to: an integer that is not one (maxExpectations, corsMaxAgeInSeconds via the environment), a long (maxSocketTimeout), a boolean that is not true/false (metricsEnabled, via the properties file), an enum constant that does not exist (binaryMessageFraming). The server still starts; GET /mockserver/config reports the raw values and GET /mockserver/configuration what each was read as.
